steps.name: remove-legacy-file-blog-loader
steps.summary: Removed the legacy file blog loader and its dedicated tests after confirming no runtime, import command, or fixture consumers. Existing content and PostgreSQL-backed public, Markdown, crawler, and search paths remain unchanged; characterization and app gates passed.

steps.name: shrink-post-publish-verification-contract
steps.summary: Kept the published-current crawler manifest used by public outputs and removed the caller-free public-surface verification, job-creation, and failure-decision facade with its dedicated tests. The required publish adapter and persistent worker remain unchanged.

steps.name: shrink-diagram-asset-contract
steps.summary: Kept the render-time diagram asset integrity predicate used by the public renderer and removed the caller-free planning, storage, failure, and audit helpers with their dedicated tests. Existing asset rows, SVG files, and public insertion behavior remain unchanged.

steps.name: shrink-admin-contract
steps.summary: Kept the PostgreSQL-backed retract and atomic admin audit boundary and removed preview, draft, publish, correction, unpublish, and generic operational actions with no live repository or route caller. Audit validation and public, crawler, search, and related removal remain unchanged.

steps.name: remove-test-only-model-mirrors
steps.summary: Removed the stale table-name and field registry plus the caller-free generation-run record factory and their dedicated assertions. Migrations and repository queries remain the schema source of truth; live domain types, article validation, content hashing, state transitions, persistence, and usage records remain unchanged.

steps.name: remove-test-only-public-data-fixture
steps.summary: Replaced the sole test import with the existing test store builders and deleted the 200-line public-data fixture. PostgreSQL-backed public reads, published-current filtering, Markdown rendering, and inline-code behavior remain unchanged.

steps.name: remove-test-only-repository-write-apis
steps.summary: Removed savePublishJob and savePublishVerification from the repository interface and implementation after confirming no non-test callers. Integration setup now uses savePost aggregate persistence and test-local rollback verification SQL; idempotency, rollback, and internal publish-job insertion remain unchanged.

steps.name: remove-redundant-blog-slug-proxy
steps.summary: Removed the extra proxy-level published-slug lookup and its helper/assertion. The Blog index and loading UI now share an index-only route group so the DB-backed detail page owns real missing/private HTTP 404 responses without a prelookup; Markdown rewrite, canonical metadata, crawler output, and privacy boundaries remain unchanged.

steps.name: prune-unused-worker-capabilities
steps.summary: Removed the unconsumed worker mode setting and manual worker egress membership. Rendered Compose differs only by those removals; internal PostgreSQL/Nginx verification, profile-gated one-shot execution, scheduler Hermes outbound, and privacy/cost boundaries are preserved. Focused and isolated PostgreSQL integration checks passed.

steps.name: deduplicate-container-runtime-defaults
steps.summary: Removed Compose and systemd overrides that duplicated the worker and auto-publish image CMD and ENV defaults. Image-owned one-shot and cycle commands plus HERMES_HOME remain the single defaults; OAuth preflight, optional HLOG_HERMES_COMMAND injection, internal worker origin, networks, dependencies, restart, and timer policy remain unchanged.
